sources.snippet: Same panelized architecture as Ketra variant: QS Link wired backbone, Clear Connect Type X wireless, 10,000+ devices, 0.1% dimming. Palladiom and Alisse keypads available. 8-year warranty. All HomeWorks-exclusive features except Ketra tunable lighting.

sources.source_name: CEDIA Integrator Feedback — HomeWorks Without Ketra
sources.snippet: Many HomeWorks installations are specified without Ketra due to cost. Integrators report the panelized architecture, keypad aesthetics, and reliability are the primary value — Ketra is a premium add-on. Standard HomeWorks is still the gold standard for new construction lighting control.

HomeWorks without Ketra vs RadioRA 3: the core difference is panelized (centralized dimming modules) vs distributed (switches at the wall). Panelized provides cleaner wall plates and centralizes all load management. RadioRA 3 is more practical for retrofits.

HomeWorks wired installations from the 2000s continue to operate flawlessly. QS Link backbone has no wireless interference issues by design. Integrators report zero communication failures on properly installed wired systems over 15+ years.
Lutron Electronics Co., Inc. — privately held, family-owned since 1961. Coopersburg, PA. 17,000+ patents. No acquisition risk. Strong corporate outlook.

bottom_line: Lutron HomeWorks QSX without Ketra retains the panelized wired architecture, QS Link backbone, Clear Connect Type X wireless, Palladiom/Alisse keypads, 10,000+ device capacity, 0.1% dimming depth, and 8-year warranty. Same architectural excellence as the Ketra variant but without tunable spectrum lighting — the system relies on the CCT of installed fixtures. Still the benchmark for wired residential lighting control. Can upgrade to Ketra later by adding Ketra fixtures and N-QS processor.
